summary: Newcomer Marta mistakes the checkout divider for a tiny fence on sale. Lukas explains its purpose and she jokes about her bread not needing a garden.
cliffhanger: Next time Marta meets the Pfand machine.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Ist dieser Mini-Zaun auch im Angebot?
scenes.fa: این حصار کوچولو هم تخفیف دارد؟
scenes.scene: Polished expressive 3D cartoon supermarket checkout. Only Marta, young adult newcomer with mustard sweatshirt and teal dungarees. Medium three-quarter view with her expressive unobstructed face and right hand visible together. She holds a short bright yellow plastic checkout divider just above the belt, studying it with playful genuine curiosity. A loaf of bread in plain paper rests beside it. The divider is clearly a small checkout bar with triangular cross-section, not an actual garden fence. Warm overhead light, teal checkout, shallow background, clear object silhouettes, no other face.
scenes.motion: Marta lifts the small yellow checkout divider a few centimeters and tilts her head inquisitively while speaking. One controlled lift, a brief raised eyebrow, natural lip sync. No frantic waving or extra fingers.
scenes.object_action: Marta lifts the checkout divider next to her bread.

scenes.speaker: lukas
scenes.de: Das ist ein Warentrenner. Der bleibt hier.
scenes.fa: این جداکنندهٔ خرید است. همین‌جا می‌ماند.
scenes.scene: Same supermarket checkout and identical yellow divider. Only Lukas, copper-haired young adult with turquoise glasses and coral hoodie. A tighter medium three-quarter shot includes face, right hand, and divider already resting flat on the belt between a loaf of bread and a plain milk carton. The rectangular divider clearly separates the two purchases. Clean colorful 3D lighting and readable composition, no other person or face.
scenes.motion: Lukas smiles gently and slides the yellow divider a short distance into place between the bread and milk while explaining. He looks toward Marta off camera, without laughing at her. Natural speech-driven lips and a single purposeful hand action.
scenes.object_action: Lukas slides the divider between the two purchases.

scenes.speaker: marta
scenes.de: Dann braucht mein Brot wohl keinen Garten!
scenes.fa: پس نانم ظاهراً به باغچه نیاز ندارد!
scenes.scene: Same checkout, same yellow divider lying on the belt beside the bread. Only Marta visible in a medium three-quarter shot, her face expressive and mouth unobstructed, bread and divider prominent beside her hand. Appealing theatrical 3D facial acting, bright warm-cool colors, strong visual hierarchy. She is amused at her own misunderstanding, not embarrassed. No garden, fantasy props or second face.
scenes.motion: Marta glances once from the divider to her bread, gives a small self-aware smile and delivers the friendly joke. She gently nudges her loaf toward the divider then rests her hand. Natural lips, a brief amused eyebrow movement, stable objects, no exaggerated laughter.
scenes.object_action: Marta nudges her bread beside the divider and smiles at her misunderstanding.
